No global instance per derived fact; a local instance bridge only where an API demands one

Sorting needs permutation and order; length preservation admits reversal and constant lists

Method or support policy is applied before minimization, or labels are indexed by policy

A finite certificate characterises frontier completeness and is checked independently of the solver
Reopening a removed premise abstracts only the leaves that used it; unused premises add nothing
A finite typed term pool (target subterms, locals, named intermediates) bounds rule instantiation

No fresh term generation inside closure; constructors only to an explicit depth or in a new epoch
Demand-driven backward slice from the goal, then forward closure on the slice

Existing automation (fun_prop, grind, arithmetic tactics, exact?) is a provider and a control, not reinvented

Correlated observations (a list and its reverse) need joint realization; (1,0) refutes nothing
